title: pouteria surumuensis
intro: Pouteria surumuensis, commonly known as Surumu, is a plant species native to Brazil, belonging to the family Sapotaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, helping to protect against various diseases and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Pouteria surumuensis include wound healing, anti-inflammatory responses, and protection against oxidative stress, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
